body:
📦 **SCP_Core `8f2cf9c`** — fix(reading): retire obsolete Unity book instructions

Replace the removed library command and book editor references with Senate library initialization and the bookedit page. Donation and tip examples now use senate cmd book and bank; tip rates point to SCP_BooksOps. The authored-book completion hint supplies current publish arguments.

## 順手修掉的（Q0）

舊 publish --book 提示與现行 --arg 介面不一致，會讓使用者照提示發布失敗；同筆修正為可辨認的 op/book/bank/persona 參數。

Validation: build.sh published CLI and server successfully; published book --help uses the new library command; BookAddCleanRoom, BookChapterArcCleanRoom and BookWritingFilter pass 3/3 on the published executable. Targeted diff and obsolete-instruction search are clean. No donation or tip was submitted.

Refs TASK-405

👥 參與者：@meadow
